_doc: Curated registry of external RasQberry demos. Each entry pins a third-party demo repository to a full 40-character commit SHA; adding or updating an entry is a reviewed RasQberry PR and is the trust anchor for external demos. Fields per entry: id (kebab-case, must match the demo's rqb-demo.json id and its repo directory name), repo_url (must be https://), ref (full 40-char commit SHA - never a branch or tag), manifest_path (path to the manifest inside the repo, usually rqb-demo.json), added (YYYY-MM-DD), note (optional curator note), name and summary (optional, shown in the catalogue picker), provider (optional, who provides and maintains the demo, shown in the install question as "Provided by <provider>."; without it: an external contributor), download (optional {download_mb, disk_mb}, shown before installing and on the first start), maturity (optional, "beta" for a new or less-tested demo: a (beta) tag in the menus and a feedback invitation at its start). Example entry: {"id": "example-demo", "repo_url": "https://github.com/someuser/example-demo.git", "ref": "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000", "manifest_path": "rqb-demo.json", "added": "2026-07-12", "note": "curator note"}. Install with: rq_demo_add_external.sh <id>. Update the pin with: rq_demo_add_external.sh --update <id>.

demos.name: traQmania
demos.note: Quantum reinforcement-learning racing demo (docker image ghcr.io/janlahmann/traqmania, public multi-arch incl. arm64). First Fun-with-Quantum-family catalog entry.

demos.name: SAP Quantum Learning
demos.summary: browser quiz and drag-and-drop circuit composer
demos.note: SAP partner demo (Sameer-kulkarni-sk, MIT): browser quiz and drag-and-drop circuit composer, served from the committed production bundle via the web-static entrypoint - no Node or npm on the Pi. Pinned commit is the PR #1 merge, which brings the root build/ and package-lock.json we asked for.

demos.name: SAP Quantum LED
demos.summary: SAP logo on the LED panel, coloured by a 3-qubit circuit
demos.note: SAP partner demo (Sameer-kulkarni-sk, Apache-2.0): SAP logo on the LED matrix with colors drawn from a 3-qubit Aer circuit each cycle. Extracted from their RasQberry-Two fork on our request (issue #273); repo renamed to match the demo id. Re-pinned 2026-09-11 to the merge of our PR #3 (logo rendered upside down: SAP_PIXELS is authored bottom-origin, draw_sap now flips the row for the top-origin canvas); manifest unchanged.
